mentions.author: tracnar
mentions.storyTitle: Why Can't Database Tables Index Themselves? (2006)
mentions.text: This talk explored a bit that idea, you could have a (full) programming language which is more like SQL so you get good enough datastructures (and indexing- without manual tuning: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gC295d3V9gE I think Prolog (another commenter pointed it out) and datalog do this to some extend.
